116    /**
117     * Generates a Russian Taxpayer Personal Identification Number
118     *
119     * @param string $area_code
120     *
121     * @return string
122     */
123    public static function inn10($area_code = '')
124    {
125        if ($area_code === '' || (int) $area_code === 0) {
126            //Simple generation code for areas in Russian without check for valid
127            $area_code = self::numberBetween(1, 91);
128        } else {
129            $area_code = (int) $area_code;
130        }
131        $area_code = str_pad($area_code, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
132        $inn_base = $area_code . static::numerify('#######');
133
134        return $inn_base . self::inn10Checksum($inn_base);
135    }
136
137    public static function kpp($inn = '')
138    {
139        if ($inn === '' || strlen($inn) < 4) {
140            $inn = self::inn10();
141        }
142
143        return substr($inn, 0, 4) . '01001';
144    }
145
146    /**
147     * Generates INN Checksum
148     *
149     * @see https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%98%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%84%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BD%D1%8B%D0%B9_%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B5%D1%80_%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%BF%D0%BB%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%89%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%B0
150     *
151     * @param string $inn
152     *
153     * @return string Checksum (one digit)
154     */
155    public static function inn10Checksum($inn)
156    {
157        $multipliers = [2, 4, 10, 3, 5, 9, 4, 6, 8];
158        $sum = 0;
159
160        for ($i = 0; $i < 9; ++$i) {
161            $sum += (int) $inn[$i] * $multipliers[$i];
162        }
163
164        return (string) (($sum % 11) % 10);
165    }
166
167    /**
168     * Checks whether an INN has a valid checksum
169     *
170     * @param string $inn
171     *
172     * @return bool
173     */
174    public static function inn10IsValid($inn)
175    {
176        return strlen($inn) === 10 && self::inn10Checksum($inn) === $inn[9];
177    }
